contributionanalytics-loading: Shown while chart data is loading.
contributionanalytics-error: Shown when chart data cannot be loaded.
contributionanalytics-no-data: Shown when no cached analytics data exists.
contributionanalytics-invalid-date:
Error message shown when a user-supplied start or end date is not a valid calendar date. Parameters:
* $1 - the invalid date value as supplied by the user
contributionanalytics-range-too-large: Error message shown when the requested date range exceeds the per-bucket maximum.
contributionanalytics-threshold-users:
Metric label for users meeting an edit threshold. Parameters:
* $1 - the minimum edit count
contributionanalytics-anonymous-users: Chart series label for anonymous users.
contributionanalytics-registered-users: Chart series label for registered users.
contributionanalytics-total: Chart series label for the total across user types.
contributionanalytics-tiles-title: Heading for the contribution tile output.
contributionanalytics-tiles-user-title:
Heading for the contribution tile output when filtered to one user. Parameters:
* $1 - user name
contributionanalytics-tiles-summary:
Summary text for the contribution tile output. Parameters:
* $1 - number of edits in the past year
contributionanalytics-tiles-edit-count:
Tooltip text for a single contribution tile. Parameters:
* $1 - number of edits on the day
contributionanalytics-tiles-less: Label for the low end of the contribution tile intensity legend.
contributionanalytics-tiles-more: Label for the high end of the contribution tile intensity legend.
